lines.text: Many learners say: My mother like tea.
With he or she, add s.

data.why: With he or she, add s.

native.hook: 第三人称单数，动词加 s！
native.tip: 中文动词不变形；英语一般现在时，主语是 he/she/it 或单数名词（如 my mother）时，动词要加 s。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “My mother like tea.”？😅 中文里“我妈妈喜欢喝茶”动词不会变，英语一般现在时，主语是单数第三人称，动词要加 s：“My mother likes tea.”跟着 Carlos 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“My mother likes tea.”免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: With he, she or one person, the verb needs s.
en.caption: Do you say “My mother like tea.”? 😅 With one person like my mother, the verb needs s: “My mother likes tea.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
